calculation.formula: IF [Parameters].[Compare Period] = "YoY" THEN DATEADD('year', -1, [Parameters].[Start Date]) ELSEIF [Parameters].[Compare Period] = "PoP" THEN DATEADD('day', -(DATEDIFF('day', [Parameters].[Start Date], [Parameters].[End Date]) + 1), [Parameters].[Start Date]) ELSE [Parameters].[Comparison Start] END
